native_mechanisms: Fold one crease per mark, each crease's angle set jointly by the mark and the previous crease (strictly sequential, carry-forward state).
Test every crease against all four wire birds' beaks at once and refold until all four agree (four parallel gauges that must be reconciled/validated per crease).
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge down to one small dense coin, discarding every scrap and failed reading (irreversible lossy finalization to fixed-size output).
core_technique: xxHash64 verbatim: four independent multiply-rotate-add accumulator lanes over 32-byte stripes, lane merge, length-mixed tail processing, and an xor-shift/multiply avalanche finalizer.
